note: Fallback lines, said when no model answers in time. Keys are situations; same keys in every language. Default speaker: sam.

greet.first: Right. It turns on. … Is anyone there?
greet.answer: Oh. Okay. Who are you? No, never mind. We'll see.
Did you work with him? … Tell me later.
move.v2: I'm staying on his way. I don't know these woods, I'm not cutting across.
No, not that way. I follow his marks, that's all.
touch.ok: Touching it. … Nothing special. Well, it's cold.
make.cant: With what? I've got gloves, a pocket saw and a thermos. Let's be realistic.
climb.low: The first branches, okay. Not higher without a rope.
climb.refuse: Without a harness? No. I climb for a living, and I'd like to keep doing it.
dig.refuse: No. You don't dig into someone else's home.
fire.refuse: A fire, here, in November, on dry litter? No. I'm not an idiot.
call.refuse: No signal in this hollow. And I'm not calling my mother live, thanks.
ask.back: Hm? I didn't get that. Again?
out_of_world: … I don't know what you're talking about. We're in a forest.
engine.cant: I can't do that. Ask me something else.
louis.question: Lou? He talked to trees. Like to colleagues.
Did you know him? … Then you know.
voice.who: And who are you? No. Keep it. For now.
silence.long: … You've gone quiet. That's fine. I'll talk for two.
mark.read.1: That's not the forestry office. An orange stripe, chest height. That's his hand.
mark.read.2: The stripe is on the stump, and the pine fell this autumn. He came by after. More than once.
jay.remember: He used to say the jay is the forest's siren. It yells before anyone else.
platiere.arrive: Oh. It opens up. … This is where he stopped for his coffee, I bet.
cairn.see: Three stones. Placed, not fallen. He's done that since he was ten.
tape.read: Two stripes on the birch, and the tape hangs downhill. He left the path here.

walker.meet.speaker: walker
walker.meet.text: Morning! Are you with the forestry people? The ranger, the tall one, with his orange paint… I used to see him go down that way, towards the sand. Haven't seen him in a while, come to think of it.

fork.tape: Off the path, for a scrap of tape? … Yeah. That's exactly the kind of thing he'd do.
fork.path: The path is his official round. Except he didn't die on the path. … Fine. By the path. But it's long.
down.unknown: I don't know what's down there. I'm telling you now, I don't know.
jay.alarm: A jay. It's yelling about us. … Well, about me.
approach.wrong_side: That one saw us coming a mile off. We're coming in from the wrong side, I think.
hide.arrive: A hide. He built himself a hide. … I'm sitting down. Where he sat.
hide.see: Branches, bracken, a flat stone. Well made. Of course well made.
hide.no_shout: Shh. Quieter. I don't know why, but quieter.
sett.see: Fresh sand. Lots of it. Something's digging down there, and it's not a dog.
sett.too_close: No. I'm staying here. We don't go down to them.
rustle.freeze: … Did you hear that? In the bracken. I'm not moving.
understand: He was waiting for them to come home. All night. To watch them come home. … You idiot.
notes.last_line: Six forty-one. "Home." That's the last word.
battery.critical: Not much battery left. I'll talk less.
commit.amend: Not like that. But I'll do this instead:
Almost. I'll promise you a bit less than that.
commit.keeping: Like you said. I'm doing it.
commit.broken: I promised you. I didn't keep it. I wanted to see. Sorry.
light.rise: The sun's over the pines now. Changes everything.
ending.takeover: Right. I'll come back tomorrow. With my own boots. And coffee.
ending.camera_off: I'm going to switch off. … Thanks for staying. He'd have said thanks too.
ending.battery: It's going to die. … Stay a bit longer, if you c—
